page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.m1.medium is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing a total of 4 vCPUs. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server type does not include any bundled local storage or GPU hardware, requiring external block storage for operating system and application data. Additionally, the underlying CPU configuration does not support advanced instruction sets such as Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), or hardware-accelerated cryptography (AES, SHA_NI).

Given the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.m1.medium offers a stable hardware profile for general-purpose workloads. It is suitable for applications that require predictable CPU performance without relying on heavy vector mathematics or local storage speed, such as standard web serving, application servers, and lightweight database hosting.
